title: Beck, Natalia Lafourcade join Gustavo Dudamel's Venezuela benefit concert
text:
The concert will be one of the final major events of Dudamel’s tenure leading the LA Phil before he concludes his 17-year run as music and artistic director.
The LA Phil is set to headline the Hollywood Bowl for A Concert for Venezuela on Aug. 23. upcoming benefit concert at the Hollywood Bowl, which will also mark his final performance as the Los Angeles Philharmonic’s music and artistic director.
, Jorge Glem, Lasso and Moisés Torrealba will perform during A Concert for Venezuela, scheduled for Aug. 23 at the Hollywood Bowl.for the one-night event, which will raise money for Dudamel’s Earthquake Recovery to Support Venezuelan Communities Fund. The initiative supports recovery efforts in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme and the Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean.said he was grateful to the artists participating in the concert and described music as “a force that unites us across borders,” adding that the event aims to bring hope and support to Venezuelan families rebuilding their communities.
